name: instagram-agent
description: Fifteen Claude skills that run an Instagram account: Reels off 26 hook formulas with a scored hook and a timed beat sheet, a research skill that finds what is working in your niche and ranks it by outlier multiple, captions linted against the feed truncation, carousels, stories, profile score, weekly plan, comments, replies, DMs, repurposing, audits, a humanizer that strips the AI fingerprint before anything ships, a code-to-video skill that builds seven-layer prompts from real repos, and a frame-driven tech motion-graphics skill with spring physics, code diffs, virtual-camera choreography and scripted render gates.
